name: certifi
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "2026.10.23" %}

{% set pip_version = "26.2.1" %}
{% set setuptools_version = "84.0.0" %}
{% set wheel_version = "0.48.0" %}
{% set python_min = "3.10" %}

package:
  name: certifi
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/c/certifi/certifi-{{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: a9895e6e2758b371e0545e321a3a8fd1fcfd9829ada8824a936dfb16aaaf36cd
    folder: certifi
    patches:
      # use the CA bundle from conda-forge's ca-certificates instead of the vendored one
      - use-conda-ca-certificates.patch
  # Download bootstrapped wheels into their respective source directories
  - url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/py3/p/pip/pip-{{ pip_version }}-py3-none-any.whl
    sha256: 71138adf1f4ca900cdb7d289c21b7494329f2332b6d85f0e1c42108c0384ed3e
    folder: boostrap_wheels
  - url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/py3/s/setuptools/setuptools-{{ setuptools_version }}-py3-none-any.whl
    sha256: 51a52592b3b99e102b609654876bd65f19f999935166d1352678931132b0c670
    folder: boostrap_wheels
  - url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/py3/w/wheel/wheel-{{ wheel_version }}-py3-none-any.whl
    sha256: 3217dcc807155e45db462d7ef2431f5ddda0d7273b700d05a67b271ceb1287ab
    folder: boostrap_wheels

build:
  number: 3
  noarch: python
  script_env:
    # Add bootstrapped wheels to `PYTHONPATH` so Python can find them for the build
    - >-
      PYTHONPATH={{ os.sep.join([SRC_DIR|default("."), "boostrap_wheels"]) ~ os.pathsep ~ os.environ.get("PYTHONPATH", "") }}
  script:
    - cd certifi
    # remove the vendored CA bundle; ca-certificates is used instead
    - {{ PYTHON }} -c "import os; os.remove(os.path.join('certifi', 'cacert.pem'))"
    - {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - ca-certificates >={{ version }}

test:
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
  imports:
    - certifi
  commands:
    - python -c "import os, certifi; assert os.path.isfile(certifi.where()), certifi.where()"
    - python -c "import certifi; assert 'BEGIN CERTIFICATE' in certifi.contents()"

about:
  home: http://certifi.io/
  license: ISC
  license_file: certifi/LICENSE
  summary: Python package for providing Mozilla's CA Bundle.
  description: |
    Certifi is a curated collection of Root Certificates for validating the
    trustworthiness of SSL certificates while verifying the identity of TLS
    hosts.
  doc_url: https://pypi.python.org/pypi/certifi
  dev_url: https://github.com/certifi/python-certifi
  doc_source_url: https://github.com/certifi/certifi.io/blob/master/README.rst

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jjhelmus
    - mingwandroid
    - jakirkham
    - pelson
    - sigmavirus24
    - ocefpaf
    - isuruf
